say:2:1423412001:1.text: Hey, uh... is this a fish stall? Doesn't look like you've got many on display.
say:2:1423412001:1.source_cn: 老板，你这里……是在卖鱼吗？摆出来的鱼不是很多呢。

say:3:1423412002:1.text: Hehe, this stall buys and sells, same as any. I deal in rare fish, but stock's running low right now.
say:3:1423412002:1.source_cn: 呵呵，小店的生意，是有买有卖的。本店主营珍奇鱼种，既收...

say:4:1423412003:1.text: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?
say:4:1423412003:1.source_cn: 您是不是从别处得了点消息，想找我诚心做买卖？
say:4:1423412003:1.male: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?
say:4:1423412003:1.female: Did you hear about me from someone? Looking to make a deal?

say:6:1423412004:1.text: Great, then we're in business. I've been trying to get my hands on a fish called the Dew Cichlid. Bring me one, and I'll pay top coin. Don't worry about bait, I've got you covered!
say:6:1423412004:1.source_cn: 那就好办了。我这里正缺一种鱼，名叫柔露慈鲷，如果您能为...
say:6:1423412004:1.male: Great, then we're in business. I've been trying to get my hands on a fish called the Dew Cichlid. Bring me one, and I'll pay top coin. Don't worry about bait, I've got you covered!
say:6:1423412004:1.female: Great, then we're in business. I've been trying to get my hands on a fish called the Dew Cichlid. Bring me one, and I'll pay top coin. Don't worry about bait, I've got you covered!

say:8:1423412006:1.text: Not too bad... though the fishing spot is a bit of a pain. It's tucked away inside the Ebon Moon Palace. You'll have to get clever to reach it. Still, good pay for hard work. Seems fair, right?
say:8:1423412006:1.source_cn: 还好，还好……只是钓点的位置有点刁钻，在……晦月之殿里...

say:9:1423412007:1.text: If you're ready, come pick out your bait!
say:9:1423412007:1.source_cn: 如果您决定好的话，就来挑些鱼饵带走吧！
